title: Huoxiang-Shihu herbal formula attenuates alcoholic-induced gastric injury by regulating the HIF-1alpha/VEGF pathway and inhibiting oxidative stress.
authors: Zheng, Yongfei; Liu, Shuang; Mao, Jiale; Li, Tao; Wu, Songquan; Zhang, Hongliang; Fu, Xin; Lei, Houxing; Ye, Qiaoyong; Wu, Shaochang; Zhang, Xiaoqin
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药复方对酒精性胃损伤的保护机制，涉及HIF-1alpha/VEGF通路和分子对接，但核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The main ingredient of the Huoxiang Shihu Chinese Medicine Formula (HS) is Chimonanthus salicifolius H. It is the first medicine of the She ethnic group. HS is a classical prescription for treating alcoholic gastritis, although its therapeutic mechanism remains uncertain. AIM OF THE STUDY: The study aimed to elucidate the therapeutic mechanism of HS in alcoholic gastritis through network pharmacology and experimental validation. METHODS: A mouse model of alcohol-induced gastritis was established and treated with oral HS decoction at doses of 1 g/kg, 2.5 g/kg, and 5 g/kg for two consecutive weeks. Gastric mucosal protection was evaluated by hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining, quantification of inflammatory markers, ELISA assays, and immunohistochemistry to assess oxidative stress levels. Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis identified chemical constituents in the HS formula. Potential targets were identified via network pharmacology and subsequently confirmed using immunohistochemistry and Western blot analysis. The binding energy of key active substances and core proteins in HS was initially determined through molecular docking. RESULTS: HS administration significantly alleviated mucosal pathology by reducing inflammatory cytokine levels, enhancing superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities, and decreasing malondialdehyde (MDA) and nitric oxide (NO) concentrations. In vitro, serum containing HS reduced intracellular ROS levels and promoted cell migration and proliferation while modulating oxidative stress-related markers. A total of 51 compounds were identified from HS, with the HIF-1alpha/VEGF axis emerging as the core mechanism. Experimental validation confirmed that HS inhibited the HIF-1alpha, VEGF, and VEGFR2 expression, regulated oxidative stress indicators (NO, MDA, SOD, CAT), and reduced inflammatory cytokines including TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. The molecular docking results indicated that diosmin in HS had the highest binding energy with VEGFR2 protein, which was -10.6 kcal/mol, and it might be the drug substance for HS to exert anti-alcoholic gastritis. CONCLUSION: HS protects against alcohol-induced gastric mucosal injury by inhibiting oxidative stress and inflammatory responses through modulation of the HIF-1alpha/VEGF axis.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：藿香石斛中药复方（HS）的主要成分为柳叶蜡梅（Chimonanthus salicifolius H.），是畲族的第一味药。HS是治疗酒精性胃炎的传统方剂，但其治疗机制尚不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学和实验验证阐明HS治疗酒精性胃炎的机制。方法：建立酒精诱导的小鼠胃炎模型，并以1 g/kg、2.5 g/kg和5 g/kg剂量的口服HS煎剂连续治疗两周。通过苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色、炎症标志物定量、ELISA检测和免疫组化评估胃黏膜保护作用及氧化应激水平。液相色谱-串联质谱（LC-MS/MS）分析鉴定HS复方中的化学成分。通过网络药理学识别潜在靶点，随后使用免疫组化和Western blot分析进行确认。通过分子对接初步确定HS中关键活性物质与核心蛋白的结合能。结果：HS给药通过降低炎症细胞因子水平、增强超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性、降低丙二醛（MDA）和一氧化氮（NO）浓度，显著缓解黏膜病理变化。体外实验中，含HS血清降低细胞内ROS水平，促进细胞迁移和增殖，同时调节氧化应激相关标志物。从HS中鉴定出共51种化合物，其中HIF-1alpha/VEGF轴为核心机制。实验验证确认HS抑制HIF-1alpha、VEGF和VEGFR2表达，调节氧化应激指标（NO、MDA、SOD、CAT），并减少包括TNF-alpha、IL-6和IL-1beta在内的炎症细胞因子。分子对接结果表明，HS中的地奥司明与VEGFR2蛋白的结合能最高，为-10.6 kcal/mol，可能是HS发挥抗酒精性胃炎作用的药效物质。结论：HS通过调节HIF-1alpha/VEGF轴抑制氧化应激和炎症反应，从而保护酒精诱导的胃黏膜损伤。
